lead.headline: Tuten is questionable, and his only cover locks at noon
lead.deck: Limited Wednesday. Marks is ruled out Thursday and Jacobs is on bye — Friday's report has to decide it.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten was limited on Wednesday with his ankle and foot and ESPN lists him questionable. Woody Marks is ruled out for Thursday, Josh Jacobs is out and on bye, and Rice and Odunze kick off at 12:00 — so nobody can replace Tuten at Jacksonville's 13:55 inactives. The rule: if Friday lists him doubtful or out, move Gordon to RB and start Rice before noon; otherwise start Tuten. Geno Smith, Wilson's quarterback, was limited too. Taylor is healthy for Thursday. The lineup as set is the projection lineup.

doFirst.headline: One rule for Sunday
doFirst.deck: Tuten starts unless Friday sits him — then Rice, before noon.
doFirst.note: Friday's Jaguars report is the trigger; at 13:55 nobody eligible is left.

cards.headline: Start Tuten — unless Friday lists him doubtful or out
cards.reason: Limited Wednesday with the ankle/foot he played through last week. Rice is the only cover and he locks at 12:00.
rows: Before 12:00 Sunday — Rice and Gordon lock then, not at 13:55
Rashee Rice in FLEX, Ollie Gordon II to RB
